# Magic Hour

> Magic Hour is a free online platform for generating AI videos and images with tools like face-swap, lip-sync, text-to-video, and image-to-video conversion.

Magic Hour offers a suite of AI-powered creative tools for video and image generation without requiring a credit card to start. The platform provides both simple and advanced features for content creators, marketers, and social media users.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-Video
- Image-to-Video
- Face-Swap-Video
- Lip Sync
- Talking Photo
- AI Headshot Generator
- AI Image Upscaler
- AI Image Editor
- Video-to-Video
- Animation
- AI Video Generator
- AI Image Generator
- Free Tools
- No Credit Card Required
- Visual Generation

## Getting Started

- [Magic Hour Home](https://magichour.ai): Magic Hour homepage showcasing AI video/image generation tools and features
- [Sign Up](https://magichour.ai/sign-up): Sign up page to register for Magic Hour AI video creation tools
- [Create Account](https://magichour.ai/create): Account creation page for Magic Hour AI video generation platform
- [Sign In](https://magichour.ai/sign-in): Login page for Magic Hour user account access
